nom: Exuviance HydraPrep pH Skin Balancing Face Toner

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination-oily skin calls it excellent alongside the matching cleanser, while a reviewer without oily skin complains it made her face more oily than before.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing normal-to-dry or dry-leaning skin report it removes makeup and cleanses without drying out or stripping the skin, though one dry-skin case broke out badly and required a dermatologist visit.
segments.combination: Several reviewers identifying combination skin (including one called 'middle-aged combination' and one six-year user) report it balances and clears pores, though one combination-skin user needed to limit use to every other night due to breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report it is gentle, non-stinging and even helpful for sensitive/rosacea-prone skin, while another says the fragrance burns and irritates sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin (including one in her 60s with rosacea) report brighter, softer, more balanced skin and describe it as part of an anti-aging routine.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report the toner leaves skin looking refreshed, brighter and 'new,' with mature-skin users citing visible improvement over time.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it hydrates or moisturizes without drying the skin, but a few explicitly note it can be drying or slightly stripping, and one says it strips natural oils entirely.
concerns.redness: One rosacea-prone reviewer reports softer, calmer skin with regular use, but another with general sensitivity reports burning and irritation from the fragrance.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say it does not strip or dry the skin and leaves it balanced and comfortable, while one reviewer reports it stripped her skin of natural oils and worsened breakouts.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for dark spots report fading or lightening over weeks of use, with no dissenting reports found.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers are divided: several report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, one reports peeling and bumps resolving, but two report it can cause peeling or worsen breakouts before improving, and one describes stripped skin with the worst breakout she'd had.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it controls oil and keeps skin balanced through the day, but one reviewer without oily skin reports it made her face oilier and returned the product.

extraits.texte: The associate who sold this to me said it was close to what I normally use. Within four days it had stripped my skin of all my natural oils and made me break out worse than I've EVER had. Returned quickly. Had to see had a dermatologist fix the mess.
While it does a decent job at hydrating, there is overwhelming fragrance and if you have sensitive skin it will burn/irritate the skin.
Have liked everything else I've used but this toner made my face even more oily than it already is. I took it back to the store to exchange it.
I have mature skin with slight rosacea. After cleansing I always use this Exuvience toner. Softer, brighter and cleaner face!! Balanced ph with needed acids. Love this stuff!

I had been struggling with finding a better toner since the one I was using left my face dry. I came upon another high end brand and it didn't work for me at all, but then I came across this! I have normal to dry skin and this removed what was left of my makeup after washing my face so good! It left my face feeling moisturized and clean, has a light scent but not too much that it's irritating. It minimizes my pores and doesn't dry my skin at all! I love it, I'm definitely going to keep buying when I'm done with this one!!

I have had bad luck with toners in the past since my skin is so sensitive, but this toner is so gentle! Not to mention it makes my skin feel super soft. I've only been using this product for a week, along with the exuviance clarifying cleanser, but I have seen a drastic change in my skin. I am prone to adult acne breakouts and it definitely helped clear that right up.

extraits.titre: Excellent results on my combo skin!
extraits.texte: I have used this toner years ago and found it to work great during a hormonal skin issue. So glad to have this product again!! I have tried several other new exfoliating toners but stinging and drying occurred with oiliness after time. This never seems to happen with this one!
